deep_read.description: Arabic Interpreter ICRC - International Committee of the Red Cross middle east region International B2 level Speaks Arabic, English, French, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish Apply Summary by Impactpool The International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC) is seeking an Arabic Interpreter to facilitate communication in sensitive contexts involving affected populations and authorities. This role requires accurate oral interpretation and written translation between Arabic and English, as well as analysis and reporting related to the ICRC's humanitarian mandate. The ideal candidate will possess strong language skills, cultural awareness, and a commitment to humanitarian work. The position involves working under pressure in potentially dangerous environments and may require unaccompanied postings. Candidate Requirements: Excellent command of English (C1) Excellent command of Arabic (C1) Proficiency in other ICRC operational languages is a strong asset 2 years of professional experience, preferably in interpretation or translation Strong motivation for humanitarian work Ability to work under pressure Open-minded and adaptable University degree in interpretation or translation is an advantage Good health and ability to pass a medical check-up Possession of a driving license for manual transmission vehicles What we do The International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC) works worldwide to provide humanitarian protection and assistance to people affected by conflict and armed violence. We take action in response to emergencies and at the same time promote respect for international humanitarian law. We are an independent and neutral organization, and our mandate stems essentially from the Geneva Conventions of 1949. We work closely with National Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies and with their International Federation in order to ensure a concerted, rational and rapid humanitarian response to the needs of the victims of armed conflict or any other situation of internal violence. We direct and coordinate the international activities conducted in these situations. Purpose Language is at the heart of humanitarian action; it enables dialogue, builds trust, and ensures that people affected by conflict can express themselves and be heard. The ICRC Interpreter plays a critical role in enabling this by facilitating accurate and meaningful communication among ICRC delegates, affected populations, authorities, and other stakeholders. Through interpretation in sensitive and complex contexts, including protection activities, visits to detainees, family reunification processes, and dialogue with parties to conflict, the Interpreter ensures that every conversation can take place with clarity, respect, and confidentiality. This is a unique, people-centered role that goes beyond translating words. It requires judgment, cultural awareness, and a deep understanding of the humanitarian principles guiding the ICRC’s work, helping build bridges of understanding where communication

title: Translator & Interpreter (Re-advertisement - for internal and external candidates), Grade 17
description: Jordan Translator & Interpreter (Re-advertisement - for internal and external candidates), Grade 17 Organization UN Relief and Works Agency for Palestine Refugees in the Near East Posted 8 Oct 2026 Closing date 21 Oct 2026 Org. Setting and Reporting UNRWA is a United Nations agency established by the General Assembly in 1949 and is mandated to provide assistance and protection to a population of some 5.8 million registered Palestine refugees. Its mission is to help Palestine refugees in Jordan, Lebanon, Syria, West Bank and the Gaza Strip to achieve their full potential in human development, pending a just solution to their plight. UNRWA's services encompass education, health care, relief and social services, camp infrastructure and improvement, microfinance, and emergency assistance. UNRWA is the largest UN operation in the Middle East with more than 30,000 staff. UNRWA is funded almost entirely by voluntary contributions. If you are looking for a rewarding opportunity to make a tangible difference for one of the most vulnerable communities in the world, UNRWA would like to hear from you. Supervisor: The incumbent reports to the Director of Communications. Responsibilities Translates documents, reports, and website content from English into Arabic and vice versa for internal or external use, ensuring accuracy and precision. Acts as interpreter at internal and external meetings, press briefings and other official occasions as required. Assists the Head of Creative Digital Multimedia Communications with editing of UNRWA's official Arab language materials; collaborates with the Communications Division's Arabic desk in these tasks. Edits and proofreads agency-wide documents, as required, including sensitive documents, pertaining to the work of the Executive Office and from other departments such as the Department of Legal Affairs, Department of Human Resources, Ethics Office, Office of the Ombudsman, Protection and Neutrality unit; and assists such departments in overseeing the final production of their key documents, bulletins and other issuances. Performs other duties as may be assigned by the Director of Communications, including, where required, in support of other offices or departments in the Agency. Competencies UN Core Values of Integrity, Professionalism and Respect for Diversity, and Core Competencies of Communication, Working with People and Drive for Results apply by default. Applying Technical Expertise Analyzing Planning and Organizing Delivering Results Demonstrating Self-Awareness Ability to work independently or in a team. Tactful and well-developed political awareness. Knowledge and experience of using computer with proficiency in word processing in English and Arabic. Education Advanced university degree (Master's or equivalent) from an accredited educational institution in English, translation and interpretation or a related field.
